headlines.title: ConocoPhillips (NYSE:COP) delivers impressive Q3 2026
headlines.summary: Oil and gas producer ConocoPhillips (NYSE:COP) reported Q3 2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with revenue up 29.2% year on year to $20.06 billion. Its GAAP profit of $3.34 per share was 11% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.title: ConocoPhillips beats third-quarter profit estimates
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- ConocoPhillips (NYSE: COP) shares are trading more than 1% higher in premarket trading on Thursday after the company reported third-quarter adjusted earnings per share of $3.27, beating the analyst estimate of $2.97 by $0.30.

headlines.summary: HOUSTON, November 05, 2026--ConocoPhillips today reported third-quarter 2026 earnings of $4.0 billion, or $3.34 per share.

description: ConocoPhillips explores for, produces, transports, and markets crude oil, bitumen, natural gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG), and natural gas liquids. It operates in five segments: Alaska; Lower 48; Canada; Europe, Middle East and North Africa; and Asia Pacific. The company's portfolio includes unconventional plays in North America; conventional assets in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia; global LNG developments; oil sands assets in Canada; and an inventory of global exploration prospects. It serves in the United States, Canada, China, Equatorial Guinea, Libya, Malaysia, Norway, Singapore, the United Kingdom, and internationally. ConocoPhillips was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
